en: A sepia-toned historical photograph of a very large group of uniformed soldiers posing on and in front of an old stone and brick fortification. The men wear long greatcoats and side caps, suggesting an interwar or World War II–era army. They are arranged on terraced stone steps and around large spherical cannonballs. On the right, above an arched entrance in the wall, a sign reads "KARA MUZEJS." In the background to the left is a multi‑storey urban building with commercial signage in a Baltic language, indicating a city setting rather than an active battlefield.
